question:
The graph shows the constant rate at which Suzanna rides her bike. If she rides a total of half an hour at the same speed, how many miles will she have ridden?

[Figure 1](figures/2009_AMC_8_Q03_question_fig1.svg)
solution:
The graph shows that Suzanna rides \(1\) mile in \(5\) minutes. Since her speed stays constant, she travels another mile during every five-minute interval.

Half an hour is \(30\) minutes, which contains
\[
30\div 5=6
\]
five-minute intervals. Therefore, she rides \(6\times 1=6\) miles, choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
